> Delete the file named `.maintenance` from your WordPress root directory, the same folder as `wp-config.php`.

It is a hidden file, so enable "show hidden files" in your file manager or use `rm .maintenance` over SSH. The site comes back immediately. Then check whether the interrupted update actually completed, because a plugin, theme, or core update stopped halfway and may have left mismatched files behind.

briefly unavailable for scheduled maintenance

Quick thread 🧵
> Delete the file named `.maintenance` from your WordPress root directory, the same folder as `wp-config.php`.
It is a hidden file, so enable "show hidden files" in your file manager or use `rm .maintenance` over SSH.
Then check whether the interrupted update actually completed, because a plugin, theme, or core update stopped halfway and may have left mismatched files behind.
